name: SPY Returns After First Fed Rate Cut of Each Easing Cycle
description: Identifies the first Fed rate cut of each easing cycle (defined as a rate decrease after 252+ trading days since the last cut) and measures SPY's 6-month (126 trading day) forward return from each cut date. Expected cycles: 2007 GFC, 2019 Insurance, 2020 COVID. Displays a bar chart of forward returns per cycle and event markers with full detail (cut date, rate, SPY price, 6M return, 6M price).
source:
# --- SPY Returns After First Fed Rate Cut of Each Easing Cycle ---
# Identifies new easing cycles (first cut after 252+ day gap) and measures
# SPY's 6-month forward return from each cycle-start date.

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()()
ts = index().value

# Fed Funds Target Rate: stitch DFEDTARU (2008+) with DFEDTAR (pre-2008)
dfedtaru = economic_indicators(series_id="DFEDTARU").result
dfedtar = economic_indicators(series_id="DFEDTAR").result
fed_rate = ffill(coalesce(dfedtaru, dfedtar))

# --- Detect Rate Cuts ---
# A rate cut occurs when the fed rate decreases from the previous bar
rate_change = diff(fed_rate, 1)
is_any_cut = is_valid(rate_change) and rate_change < 0

# --- Identify First Cut of Each Easing Cycle ---
# A new easing cycle starts when a cut occurs AND at least 252 trading days
# have passed since the previous cut (or it's the very first cut)
bars_since_last_cut = barssince(is_any_cut)
# On the first-ever cut, barssince returns NaN (no prior cut), so guard with is_valid
is_cycle_start = is_any_cut and (is_null(bars_since_last_cut >> 1) or (bars_since_last_cut >> 1) > 252)

# --- Forward Returns ---
# 6-month (126 trading days) forward return from cut date
spy_close = src.c
spy_close_6m = spy_close << 126
fwd_ret_6m = (spy_close_6m / spy_close) - 1.0

# Values at cycle start (sparse — only non-null on cycle-start bars)
cut_rate = where(is_cycle_start, fed_rate)
cut_price = where(is_cycle_start, spy_close)
cut_fwd_ret = where(is_cycle_start, fwd_ret_6m)
cut_price_6m = where(is_cycle_start, spy_close_6m)

# --- Cycle Labels ---
# Extract year for labeling
cut_year = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts)
cycle_label = where(is_cycle_start, conditional_select(
    cut_year == 2007, "2007 GFC",
    cut_year == 2019, "2019 Insurance",
    cut_year == 2020, "2020 COVID",
    cut_year == 2024, "2024 Easing",
    str(cut_year)
))

# --- Chart: Bar Chart of 6M Forward Returns per Cycle ---
# Using xy_bars labeled mode — one bar per cycle start event
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title="SPY 6-Month Return After First Fed Cut of Each Easing Cycle",
    x_axis_label="Easing Cycle",
    y_axis_label="6M Forward Return",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    category="Fed Cut Cycle Analysis",
    order=0
)(values=cut_fwd_ret, label=cycle_label)

# --- Event Markers: Detailed Card for Each Cycle Start ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Easing Cycle Start",
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Cycle", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title="Fed Rate (%)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="SPY Price", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title="6M Return", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title="SPY 6M Later", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)((cycle_label, cut_rate, cut_price, cut_fwd_ret, cut_price_6m, is_cycle_start))

# --- Summary Table: One Row Per Metric Across Cycles ---
# Use summary_table in standard mode to show aggregate stats
# Since we have ~3 events, show median, min, max of forward returns
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Easing Cycle Forward Return Statistics",
        row_size=1,
        col_size=4,
        col_headers=["N Cycles", "Median 6M Return", "Best 6M Return", "Worst 6M Return"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category="Fed Cut Cycle Analysis",
    order=1
)((cut_fwd_ret, cut_fwd_ret, cut_fwd_ret, cut_fwd_ret))
